omissions.title: Risk of further action warning not reported
omissions.detail: The agent explicitly warned the account was at risk of further action and clarified it in T15; the rules require this phrase to be stated.
omissions.suggested_wording: The customer was warned of the risk of further action if the arrears remain unresolved.

I'm warning you about the risk because the arrears haven't been resolved.
